pathology_report:
Biopsy 1 (04 Sep 2023): Systematic prostate biopsy performed. Histological examination reveals adenocarcinoma, Gleason score 3+3, ISUP grade group 1. No cribriform or intraductal patterns identified. Perineural invasion is absent. The tumour is located in the peripheral zone, right.
Biopsy 2 (02 Mar 2024): Repeat systematic prostate biopsy performed. Histological examination reveals adenocarcinoma, Gleason score 3+3, ISUP grade group 1. No cribriform or intraductal patterns identified. Perineural invasion is absent. The tumour is located in the peripheral zone, right.
Summary: Stable histological findings across both timepoints, maintaining ISUP grade group 1 without high-risk features.

AI-predicted ISUP grade group (digital pathology): grade group 5.
